# .NET initializr

> Browser-based .NET project scaffolding tool at https://starter.dotnetth.com

## What it does

.NET initializr generates production-ready .NET solution structures. Users configure their project options in the browser and download a fully structured solution as a zip file. Everything runs client-side via Blazor WebAssembly — no server round-trips.

It also provides the equivalent `dotnet new` CLI command so users can reproduce the same project from the terminal.

## Configurable Options

### Project Basics
- **Project Name**: Custom project and namespace naming
- **.NET SDK**: .NET 8 (LTS), .NET 9, .NET 10 (LTS)
- **Project Type**: Minimal API, Controller-based Web API, Console, Worker Service

### Architecture
- **Clean Architecture**: Multi-project (Domain / Application / Infrastructure / API)
- **Vertical Slice Architecture**
- **Simple Layered**: Single project

### Data Access
- **ORM**: Entity Framework Core, Dapper, or None
- **Database**: PostgreSQL, SQL Server, MySQL, SQLite

### Authentication
- JWT Bearer
- ASP.NET Core Identity (requires EF Core)
- Keycloak OIDC
- API Key (custom middleware)

### Logging
- Serilog (file sink)
- NLog

### API Documentation
- Scalar
- Swagger UI
- ReDoc

### Background Jobs
- IHostedService
- Hangfire (requires a database)
- Quartz.NET

### Containers & DevOps
- Dockerfile + .dockerignore
- Docker Compose
- .NET Aspire orchestration
- GitHub Actions CI/CD
- Azure DevOps Pipelines

### Observability & Quality
- Health Checks
- OpenTelemetry (tracing + metrics)
- Redis caching
- FluentValidation
- HTTP Resilience (Polly)

### Testing
- **Frameworks**: xUnit, NUnit
- **Assertions**: Shouldly
- **Add-ons**: NSubstitute, Bogus, Testcontainers

## Links
- Website: https://starter.dotnetth.com
- Source: https://github.com/dotnetthailand/starter-net
